sanskrit: मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि । अथ चेत्त्वमहङ्कारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्क्ष्यसि ॥
hindiTranslation: मेरेमें चित्तवाला होकर तू मेरी कृपासे सम्पूर्ण विघ्नोंको तर जायगा और यदि तू अहंकारके कारण मेरी बात नहीं सुनेगा तो तेरा पतन हो जायगा ॥
englishTranslation: Centered in me, you will cross all obstacles through my grace. But if you do not listen because of ego, you will fall.
essence: Grace opens the way; ego closes it.
speaker: Krishna
simpleMeaning: Keep your attention fixed on the divine, and you can cross every obstacle through grace. Refuse that guidance out of ego, and you will fall.
simpleInsight: Surrender brings relief; resistance makes the same path collapse.
detailedMeaning: After teaching action, offering, and surrender, Krishna now warns him plainly: stay inwardly with me and obstacles lose their power; let ego block hearing, and ruin follows.
modernRelevance: A young man in a court case ignores his lawyer's advice out of pride and insists on his own plan. Krishna's warning fits: listen and difficulties can be crossed; let ego block the hearing and you fall.
translationLiteral: मच्चित्तः (with mind fixed on me) / सर्वदुर्गाणि (all difficulties) / मत्प्रसादात् (by my grace) / तरिष्यसि (you will cross over) / अथ (but) / चेत् (if) / त्वम् (you) / अहङ्कारात् (from ego) / न (not) / श्रोष्यसि (you will listen) / विनङ्क्ष्यसि (you will perish/fall)
insight: Krishna gives Arjuna a promise and a warning: with mind on him you cross every obstacle, through ego you perish.

quoteVariants.text: Keep your mind on me. Grace carries you through every obstacle.
The obstacle is not the obstacle. Ego is.
